w10_T4_004575: Ari's stamp album held 239 stamps. Ari is 14 years old. He gave 147 stamps to his younger cousin and then bought 76 stamps at a fair. His friend Bo's album had 3 times as many stamps as Ari's, and Bo owned 7 such albums, each with the same number of stamps. Bo also had 6 loose stamps in a drawer. How many stamps did Bo have altogether?
w10_T4_004590: Cy keeps his savings as nickels in a jar, and the jar held 106 nickels. He took out 93 nickels to buy a football, 9 nickels for a snack, and 3 nickels for a sticker. His grandmother then dropped 48 nickels into the jar. Since a nickel is worth 5 cents, Cy worked out the value of the jar in cents. How many cents was Cy's jar worth?
w10_T4_004594: In the morning a baker made 32 batches of buns with 9 buns in each batch. She packed the buns equally into 4 boxes and sent one box to the cafe on the corner. The cafe seats 40 people. In the afternoon the cafe cut every bun in its box into 3 pieces for a sampling tray. In the evening the pieces were divided equally onto 4 platters. How many pieces were on the first platter?
w10_T4_004599: A community hall had 199 chairs, and the trust that runs it bought 33 more for that hall. The trust owns 5 identical halls in the town, each with the same number of chairs, and it runs the same set-up in each of its 4 towns. Each chair weighs 6 kilograms. The trust then sold 1833 chairs as surplus and sent 2458 chairs to storage. How many chairs did the trust have left in use?
w10_T4_004604: A nature trail was 168 yards long, and the rangers extended it by 73 yards. Since a yard is 3 feet, the new trail sign gives the length in feet. A 50-foot stretch was later closed after a landslide, and a 45-foot boardwalk was added at the far end. How many feet long is the open trail now?
w10_T4_004605: Dee's shop had 128 six-packs of soda, and since each six-pack holds 6 cans, she counted her stock in cans. Over the weekend she sold 669 cans. Her rival Eli had 6 times as many cans as Dee had left. Eli divided his cans equally between his 2 branches. The east branch then sold 84 cans. How many cans did the east branch have left?
w10_T4_004607: A single dairy signed a 96-week contract to supply a school, but the school cancelled 50 of those weeks. Since a week has 7 days, the dairy's planner rewrote the contract in days, and the school then added 13 extra days. The dairy delivers 6 gallons of milk on every contracted day. The school's kitchen measures milk in pints, and since a gallon is 8 pints, the cook converted the whole contract into pints. How many pints of milk does the contract cover?
w10_T4_004608: The laundry basket held 72 pairs of socks. Fran added 24 pairs from the dryer, then put 42 pairs away in drawers. The washing machine runs for 40 minutes. Fran then counted the basket in single socks, since each pair is 2 socks. She washed 65 socks and hung them outside, lost 19 socks behind the machine, and gave 11 socks to the dog to chew. How many socks were left in the basket?
w10_T4_004609: In the morning Ike started a puzzle game with 115 points and earned 46 points on the first level. In the afternoon he reached a level where every point he held was worth 4 points, then he found a chest worth 57 points and lost 79 points in a trap. In the evening he hit a level where every point he held was worth 7 points, and he finished with a bonus of 72 points. How many points did Ike have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004620: Jo's lawn measured 76 square yards, and she added 36 square yards by clearing a couple of old flower beds. Since a square yard is 9 square feet, she measured the lawn in square feet for the turf order. She paved 423 square feet of it for a patio, then reclaimed 7 square feet by removing a path. Her neighbour Kim's lawn was 418 square feet smaller than Jo's. How many square feet was Kim's lawn?
w10_T4_004624: In the morning a corner shop had 44 six-packs of lemonade on the shelf. The shop is open 10 hours a day. In the afternoon a delivery brought 22 more six-packs and a second van brought 11. Since a six-pack holds 6 cans, the owner counted the stock in cans. In the evening a party group bought 272 cans. How many cans of lemonade were left?
w10_T4_004633: Lena had 153 stickers in her album. She won a contest that doubled her collection. She then bought 58 stickers at the market. A trade with her cousin tripled her collection. Her aunt sent her 71 stickers. How many stickers did Lena have?
w10_T4_004635: Mia had 183 coins in her jar, more coins than Nils had in his. She then found a second stash of exactly the same size, so she had 2 times as many coins. Her mother added 62 coins. Mia divided all the coins equally into 4 jars and took 1 jar to the bank, where the teller added 54 coins that had been found in an old account. How many coins were in the jar Mia took to the bank?
w10_T4_004637: In the morning a bakery had 24 trays of bread. It sold 11 trays to a restaurant and then received 55 trays from its second kitchen. Each loaf weighs 500 grams. In the afternoon the staff counted loaves instead of trays, since every tray held 9 loaves, and every loaf was then cut into 4 quarters for the sandwich bar. In the evening the quarters were packed 6 to a bag. How many bags were packed?
w10_T4_004643: A cafe fills a 149-gallon tank of water each day but has 130 gallons left every evening. Each cafe seats 30 people. The chain's 4 cafes all use the same amount. The chain logs water in pints, and since a gallon is 8 pints, the manager converted the daily figure to pints. He then worked out the weekly figure, since a week has 7 days, and added 29 pints for cleaning the tanks. How many pints of water does the chain use in a week?
w10_T4_004650: A brewery had 239 crates of bottles, but 33 crates were damaged in transit. The brewery has 15 staff. Each crate holds 7 boxes, and each box holds 6 bottles. During the festival the brewery sold 7681 bottles. It then tripled its remaining stock with a new batch. How many bottles did the brewery have in stock?
w10_T4_004656: In the morning Ray's dairy collected 81 gallons of milk. Since a gallon is 8 pints, and a pint is 2 cups, Ray recorded the morning's milk in cups. In the afternoon Sal's dairy reported 9 times as many cups as Ray's. Sal's dairy produced the same amount on each of 8 days. In the evening of the last day Sal added 36 cups from a spare churn and 74 cups from a late milking. How many cups of milk did Sal's dairy produce in all?
w10_T4_004668: Tom's shop had 177 mugs in stock and received 39 more. Uma's shop across the road had 2 times as many mugs as Tom. Uma's shop is 6 years old. Uma took delivery of 75 mugs, then 36 more, and sold 142 mugs. Each of her remaining mugs was priced at 4 dollars. How many dollars were Uma's remaining mugs worth?
w10_T4_004675: A tiler lays 13 tiles in each row, with 8 rows on each panel. Each wall has 4 panels, and each floor of the building has 7 walls. The tiler doubled the count because every tile is laid in a second layer for insulation. He added 58 spare tiles to the order. The same order was repeated for each of 8 buildings. How many tiles did the tiler order?
w10_T4_004679: A bag of 105 sweets was shared equally among 3 children, and Vi was one of them. Vi then got 9 sweets from her aunt, 42 sweets from a party bag, and 75 sweets on Halloween. Her brother Wes ate all of his share, so Vi ended with more sweets than Wes. How many sweets did Vi have?
w10_T4_004687: In the morning Xan set up his stall with 5 crates of peaches, 117 peaches in each crate, and a neighbour gave him a dozen more. In the afternoon he learned the market would run for 7 days and that he would have the same number of peaches to sell each day. In the evening Xan and 2 other sellers agreed to divide the whole week's peaches equally among the 3 of them, and Xan then picked 36 extra peaches for his own share. How many peaches did Xan have to sell over the week?
w10_T4_004691: Yaz's orchard has 178 apple trees, and each tree gave 8 apples this year. Zia's orchard produced 5 times as many apples as Yaz's. Zia picked 9 more apples from a wild tree by the road. She then sold 1129 apples at the market. How many apples did Zia have left?
w10_T4_004694: A cafe had 147 pints of milk in its fridge and used 139 pints over the weekend. A delivery on Monday brought 79 pints. The barista measures milk by the cup, and since a pint is 2 cups, she worked out the milk in cups. A neighbouring cafe lent her 41 cups of milk. How many cups of milk did the cafe have?
w10_T4_004699: In the morning a shelter had 84 blankets, and a single van delivered 67 more. In the afternoon 140 blankets were handed out to families. In the evening a church sent 76 blankets and a school sent 78. How many blankets did the shelter have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004708: Ben started the term with 18 hours of tutoring credit. The tutor logs sessions in minutes, converting each hour into minutes for her records, but Ben keeps his own count in hours. He bought 6 more hours of credit. The tutor charges 40 dollars an hour. Ben used 11 hours in September, 8 hours in October, and 1 hour in November. How many hours of credit does Ben have left?
